description.en:
Returns a random integer from min up to max - 1 (max is excluded). If min equals max, it returns min without drawing.
The numbers come from the match's own random generator (a xorshift generator kept in the match state); each call advances it.
Despite the BTL prefix it is also used outside matches, by several map scripts.
max should be greater than min: with max below min, the range wraps around and the result is not meaningful.
Smallest value that can be returned.
Upper bound, never returned (except when equal to min).

A random integer in [min, max - 1].
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.
